cause: EmulationSession treated achievement loading as an implicit pause, also disabling rewind/frame advance. This gate was introduced with achievements (6bad1233), not with the 0.17.0 diagnostic UI. Remote response latency became game-start latency on every ROM switch.
change: Removed achievement HTTP loading from gameplay/pause/rewind/frame-step gates
GameReady notice remains emitted only by the successful validated game-data callback
Login/game/media errors and a 15-second no-response timeout produce one LoadFailed notice; frontend renders a 3.5-second OSD if notifications and OSD are enabled
No modal errors, no forced pause/reset on ordinary load failure; late timed-out responses are ignored
Recorded immediate feedback/non-blocking optional services rule in AGENTS.md

validation.linux: Achievement loading: ROMs run during pending login/game requests, success, HTTP failure and no-response timeout passed
validation.windows: Achievement loading: ROMs run during pending login/game requests, success, HTTP failure and no-response timeout passed
validation.network: Entirely mocked, no live requests/accounts; original generated ROM fixtures
cases: Game frames while achievement set is pending
Second ROM and HTTP400: frames continue and one LoadFailed
Third ROM and complete no-response: frames continue through real 15s timeout; one LoadFailed; late response ignored

windows_native_load_benchmark.data: Isolated temporary data directory, no user saves/settings modified
windows_native_load_benchmark.limits: Measures host load, slot checks, game hash and first emulated frame; not click-to-display latency. First call includes DLL/core initialization. Four calls, alternating two ROMs.
